name: Cafe Shillong
signature_dish: Roasted pork ribs + Sunday live music
why_it_matters: One of Shillong's most-loved cafes — wooden floors, leather sofas, and a continental-leaning menu with strong Khasi pork dishes. Known for hosting some of the best live music in town, including Sunday performances by Shillong rock legend Lou Majaw and emerging local acts.
insider_tip: Sunday evenings get packed for the live music sets — arrive by 6.30 PM or call ahead. Closes 9.30 PM, slightly later than most Laitumkhrah cafes.
signature_address: Below NIIT, LP Building, Main Road, Laitumkhrah, Shillong, Meghalaya 793003

name: Cafe Shillong Heritage
why_it_matters: Sister cafe to Cafe Shillong, set in the serene grounds of Tripura Castle. Started by Larsing Ming Sawyan and William Diengdoh in 2012. Known for Sunday acoustic sets where young Shillong musicians perform old classics and original compositions.
insider_tip: Try the heritage outdoor seating — quieter than the Laitumkhrah branch and surrounded by pine trees. Sunday performances start around 6 PM.
signature_address: Tripura Castle Road, Cleve Colony, Shillong, Meghalaya 793003

name: Dylan's Cafe
signature_dish: Bob Dylan tribute cafe + all-day breakfast
why_it_matters: Northeast India's first tribute cafe dedicated to Bob Dylan. The decor is layered with quirky Dylan memorabilia, comfortable couches and tiles painted by visitors that adorn the ceiling. Hearty comfort menu with all-day breakfast, succulent burgers, steaks and desserts.
insider_tip: Open till 10 PM — one of the few Shillong cafes that stays open later than 9 PM. Paint a tile and add it to the ceiling collection.
signature_address: Lower Lachumiere, near Don Bosco Square, Laitumkhrah, Shillong, Meghalaya 793003

name: ML 05 Cafe
why_it_matters: Shillong's first concept cafe celebrating the city's love for cars, bikes and food, named after Meghalaya's vehicle registration code (ML 05). Sits on the Cherrapunji highway inside the Horti Hub Compound — biker hangout with a quiet pine-tree garden. Linked to Polo Towers group.
insider_tip: It's actually 5th Mile Upper Shillong, on the way to Elephant Falls and Cherrapunji — perfect mid-trip break, not a Laitumkhrah walk-in. The outdoor deck is the spot.
signature_address: 5th Mile, Upper Shillong, Sohra Road, Inside Horti Hub Compound, Shillong, Meghalaya 793009

name: Trattoria
why_it_matters: A no-fuss, plain-tables Khasi joint that locals point to first when asked where to eat real Shillong food. Served from an open kitchen on Police Bazar Road, opposite Delhi Misthan Bhandar — bare interior, mouth-watering pork.
insider_tip: Lunch only — open roughly 11 AM to 4 PM. Get there before 1 PM or the jadoh runs out. Cash and small queues are normal.
signature_address: Police Bazar Road, opposite Delhi Misthan Bhandar, Shillong, Meghalaya 793001

name: Jadoh Stall (Don Bosco Square)
why_it_matters: A charming little Khasi cafe at Don Bosco Square that sells exactly what it's named after. Hearty portions, budget-friendly, popular with local students — one of the most accessible places to try authentic jadoh and dohneiiong without a Bara Bazaar stall hunt.
insider_tip: Lunch is served from the morning's pot — go early for the freshest jadoh. Vegetarians should ask in advance; the menu is meat-led.
signature_address: Don Bosco Square, Laitumkhrah, Shillong, Meghalaya 793003

name: Nat Khasi Restaurant
why_it_matters: Open-air Khasi-Jaintia eatery tucked next to the fruit market inside Iewduh (Bara Bazaar) — Shillong's century-old indigenous market. No tables in the western sense: you order, find a stool, eat. The most honest, cheapest authentic Khasi meal in the city.
insider_tip: Bara Bazaar is closed on Sundays. Iewduh's most chaotic day is Wednesday (the traditional market day) — get there before noon for full menu.
signature_address: Iewduh Market (Bara Bazaar), near fruit section, Shillong, Meghalaya 793002

name: City Hut Family Dhaba
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor's #1-ranked Shillong restaurant for years — a family dhaba that locals and tourists agree on. Cozy family section, a kitschy artificial waterfall and wishing well, fast service and Punjabi-Chinese-tandoor menus that feed groups easily.
insider_tip: Long queues 7-9 PM during peak season — call ahead for a family-section table. Veg menu is genuinely large, unusual for Shillong.
signature_address: Oakland Road, Earle Holiday Home, Police Bazar, Shillong, Meghalaya 793001
